text:
j_smith (ACME): Hey team -- our invoice for Mar 3 is ~40k tokens higher than the dashboard for our Private VPC deployment. Dashboard: 120,312 tokens, Invoice: 160,457. Agent id acme-vpc-13, we did a rolling update last night. Can someone help investigate?

Maya (support): Sorry about that, we'll take a look. Can you share agent version and the exact restart window?

j_smith (ACME): agent: acme-vpc-13, version=1.19.0 (rolled from 1.18.3), last restart seen at 2026-03-02T02:13:00Z during the rollout. The customer audit logs show a flush then a replay within ~5s.

Maya (support): forwarding to metering/SRE. @Priya @Ethan — tagging you. deploy-bot shows the rollout completed at 2026-03-02T02:12:58Z.

deploy-bot: Rolling update acme-vpc-13 -> 1.19.0 finished on node-7 (02:12:58 UTC) :white_check_mark: 

Priya (metering-eng): Hi — can you paste the last 200 lines of /var/log/redwood-meter.log and output of `redwood-meterctl status --json`? Also confirm host NTP state.

j_smith (ACME): pasted logs below (sanitized):

```
[2026-03-02T02:12:57Z] INFO flush: buffer_id=buf-923 start_seq=4294967294 end_seq=4294967299 size=6
[2026-03-02T02:12:58Z] INFO heartbeat: seq=0 uptime=3s
[2026-03-02T02:12:58Z] WARN restart: graceful=false
[2026-03-02T02:13:03Z] INFO replay: buffer_id=buf-923 start_seq=0 end_seq=5 size=6
[2026-03-02T02:13:04Z] INFO flush: buffer_id=buf-923 start_seq=0 end_seq=5 size=6
```

j_smith (ACME): Also seeing chrony logs with a small step around 02:12:59Z (host NTP adjusted forward ~4s).

Ethan (sre): That pattern (seq near 4294967294 -> wrap to 0) plus a restart during flush looks suspicious. Could be a uint32 wrap + epoch normalization bug + aggressive retry that led to the same logical token window being submitted twice under different seq ranges (pre-wrap and post-wrap). Meter storage dedupe key is agent_id+seq and we didn't include an epoch offset in 1.19.0.

Priya (metering-eng): Confirmed on quick skim. 1.19.0 changed the flush/retry path to re-enqueue outstanding windows on restart to avoid data loss. In most cases that helps, but if seq wrapped (very long-lived connections / large seq space) and host clock stepped during restart, the dedupe key normalized incorrectly and produced duplicated ledger entries. Looks like the buffer `buf-923` was flushed twice: once before the restart (seq 4294967294..4294967299) and again after restart as 0..5. Both were accepted by the meter because the dedupe routine treated seq numbers modulo 2^32 with no epoch.

Maya (support): Ok — what's the immediate mitigation for the customer? They want both reconciliation steps and an invoice credit proposal.

Priya (metering-eng): Two parts: 1) reconciliation script to collapse duplicate events for that buffer/time window and produce corrected token counts; 2) a hotfix (1.19.1) to include an epoch prefix in dedupe keys and to add a 60s guard against re-flushing the same buffer id. For now we can run the reconciliation and then bill adjust.

Ethan (sre): Example commands for export + dedupe (run on the private control-plane or provide to customer if they can run locally):

```
# export events for agent and window
redwood-admin export-events --agent acme-vpc-13 --start "2026-03-02T02:10:00Z" --end "2026-03-02T02:20:00Z" > /tmp/acme_events.ndjson

# dedupe by (agent_id, buffer_id, normalized_seq)
python3 - <<'PY'
import sys, json
seen=set()
for line in open('/tmp/acme_events.ndjson'):
    ev=json.loads(line)
    # normalize seq: if seq<1000 and ev['seq_hint']>4294960000 then seq+=2**32
    seq=ev['seq']
    if seq<1000 and ev.get('seq_hint',0)>4294960000:
        seq += 2**32
    key=(ev['agent_id'], ev['buffer_id'], seq)
    if key in seen:
        continue
    seen.add(key)
    print(json.dumps(ev))
PY
```

Priya (metering-eng): That script is a rough local dedupe that uses a heuristic (seq_hint is recorded by our agent as the last pre-restart seq if available). We'll run a safer reconcile from control plane which also consults the ledger and audit log and produce a corrected token delta.

Maya (support): @Omar (billing) can you hold invoice adjustment until we confirm the reconcile output? We'll propose provisional credit equal to invoice - dashboard (40,145 tokens) if reconcile shows duplicates.

Omar (billing): Ack. I can prepare a provisional credit note JIRA once we confirm. Please tag me with the reconcile report.

j_smith (ACME): We're able to run the export but don't have `seq_hint` in our NDJSON export. Any alternative?

Priya (metering-eng): If no seq_hint, use buffer_id + timestamp window + token sum signature to identify duplicates. Example: collapse events with same buffer_id where event_timestamp between 02:12:55 and 02:13:06 and token_sum matches. We'll run server-side reconcile if you can grant the support token (one-time expiring token).

j_smith (ACME): I'll share a one-time token via DM now.

Maya (support): Received DM, starting reconcile run. ETA ~45m. I'll post the reconciliation report here.

meter-bot: Reconcile job started for acme-vpc-13 by Maya (job id rec-7753)

Priya (metering-eng): Follow-up note for engineering: add unit tests around uint32 wrap and restart for agent flush flow. Also add a metric to detect multiple flushes for same buffer_id within 2 minutes.

Lena (pm): Thanks — can we also surface this scenario in release notes for 1.19.1 and add a short KB article for customers running long-lived agents?

Maya (support): Reconcile complete: meter-bot posted a short report. Attaching summary:

```
reconcile-report rec-7753:
  agent: acme-vpc-13
  window: 2026-03-02T02:10:00Z -> 2026-03-02T02:20:00Z
  original_ledger_tokens: 160,457
  dashboard_tokens: 120,312
  duplicates_identified: 40,145 (buffer_id buf-923 duplicated across pre/post-restart)
  adjusted_tokens: 120,312
  action: corrected ledger entries collapsed; provisional credit recommended 40,145 tokens
```

Maya (support): Omar — please create the billing credit for 40,145 tokens and mark as provisional until accounting final sign-off.

Omar (billing): Created billing ticket BILL-3241, provisional credit queued. Will finalize after accounting verifies reconcile export.

j_smith (ACME): Thanks everyone. Appreciate the quick help and the clear steps. Please keep us posted on hotfix timeline for 1.19.1.

Priya (metering-eng): Hotfix 1.19.1 scheduled for canary tomorrow 06:00 UTC; patch will include epoched dedupe keys + 60s buffer_id guard. We'll post the release notes and KB.

Maya (support): Closing this thread once credit is finalized. Current status: in_progress -> reconcile done -> billing provisional credit queued -> hotfix scheduled.

Ethan (sre): Postmortem note: root cause = agent flush retry + seq wrap + lack of epoch in dedupe key + small NTP step during rolling update. Mitigation: reconcile, hotfix, release notes, add metrics and unit tests.

j_smith (ACME): Got it — thanks all.
